text:
A border collie won best in show at the Eddlestone Dog Trials on Saturday, taking the top prize on the final day of the event.

The result was announced by Marguerite Holloway, chief steward of the Eddlestone Canine Association, following the closing ceremony on 14 September 2024. In all, 212 dogs across 31 breeds competed over the course of the trials.

The result was confirmed in the association's official results bulletin, issued after the ceremony.

"It was a strong field from start to finish, and the border collie earned the title," Holloway said. "Every handler and every dog who took part should be proud of the work they put in."

The Eddlestone Dog Trials drew entrants from a wide range of breeds, with the final day bringing the competition to a close. The association's bulletin lists the full results for the event.
